data.action: 抱粉色灯笼写下分享美食的愿望，将绘马举向镜头
data.description: 蜜璃穿着浅绿浴衣抱着粉色灯笼，在绘马架前认真写下“大家一起吃很多好吃的”；她把绘马举向镜头，绿瞳里的愿望比灯火更亮。
data.lighting: pink lantern light beneath the evening sky
data.mood: 恋柱把幸福愿望写给所有人
data.promptProse: Mitsuri holds the pink lantern in one hand and raises the finished ema toward the viewer with the other. Its warm light reaches the wooden plaque beneath the evening sky.
data.title: 甘露寺蜜璃 · 祭典灯笼的愿望
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the lantern; the other raises the finished ema toward the viewer.
